comparison.objective: Place two markers at one-third and two-thirds of a cable's routed length without moving the cable.
comparison.physical_skill: Estimating arc length and placing markers beside a deformable route versus impact tooling and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Markers stand at the two fractional positions and are released; positional tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests measurement along a route without disturbing it, not fracture or containment.
